title: Capability manifest
description: The governed contract for something a user or service can ask an agent to do.

conformance.description: L1 documented, L2 validated, L3 gateway-enforced.

model.description: Declare a logical tier, specific models per provider, or both. At least one is required.

tier.description: Logical tier, resolved per provider via models/tiers.yaml.

pin.description: Specific model per provider, e.g. { anthropic: claude-sonnet-5-5 }. A pin for the active provider wins over the tier.

inputs.description: JSON Schema for what the caller provides.

outputs.description: JSON Schema for what the capability returns.

context.description: Path to a context template (Markdown with front matter).

governor.description: Path to a token governor file.

permissions.description: Path to a permissions policy file.

evals.description: Path to an evals directory. Required at L2 and above.
